assumptions.evaluator: amcrax.optimisation.evaluate_result defaults: heat deficit by burning grey NH3 (economics heat_import_mode ammonia_fuel; CI grey/self_firing), grid singapore_2024, NH3 450 USD/t, cracked-gas compression electricity when PSA feed < 7 bar

reactor_temperature_C.basis: range of the Aspen Plus V15 temperature sweep (results/sensitivity/aspen_temperature.csv)

reactor_pressure_bar.basis: range of the Aspen pressure sweep (aspen_pressure.csv); flowsheet minimum is 3 bar

psa_h2_recovery.basis: range of the Aspen PSA-recovery sweep (aspen_psa_recovery.csv); literature PSA points 0.71-0.81 (separation.yaml)

fehe_hot_end_approach_K.basis: range of the Aspen FEHE-approach sweep (aspen_fehe_approach.csv)

constraint_definitions.fehe_feasibility: FEHE feasibility: no temperature cross. The process model raises FlowsheetSpecError for a cross (41-point counter-current T-Q profile) or a cold outlet below the cold inlet; g = min internal dT - fehe_min_internal_dT_K (default 0 K = 'no cross'). Model failure counts as infeasible.
constraint_definitions.min_nh3_conversion: Minimum equilibrium NH3 conversion, g = X - min_nh3_conversion. DESIGN ASSUMPTION, default 0.95: limits the NH3 load sent to the PSA/tail-gas burner (NOx precursor, not modelled). Literature crackers report 99.42 % and 99.6 % (hansen2024hysys p. 4 Table 3, p. 5 Table 4); a 0.99 variant is reported separately. The baseline (600 degC, 20 bar) has X = 0.981.
constraint_definitions.max_cracked_gas_nh3_mole_frac: Optional maximum NH3 mole fraction in S5 (off by default).
constraint_definitions.product_purity: H2 purity >= min_h2_purity (default 0.99, separation.yaml product_purity_spec, chopra2026decentralized p. 4 Sec. 2.2). Implied by the reduced-order splitter (fixed N2 slip, NH3/H2O fully retained), so it is reported but practically never active.
constraint_definitions.thermal_self_sufficiency: Optional: net_fuel_heat_deficit_kW <= 0 (tail-gas heat covers all external heating), g = -deficit.
constraint_definitions.kinetic_feasibility: NOT IMPLEMENTED (unfinished): catalyst-mass bound from amcrax.reactor.

results.driver: variable bounds: psa_h2_recovery=upper, fehe_hot_end_approach_K=lower; PSA feed-pressure requirement kink: PSA feed pressure = 7 bar (cho2026nickel p. 6 Table 3), below which cracked-gas compression is charged; the optimum pressure is set by this literature requirement
model_limitation: psa_h2_recovery at its upper bound (0.95): bound-driven, not a discovered interior optimum. PSA size, bed count, cycle and the recovery-purity trade-off are not modelled (reduced-order splitter with fixed N2 slip); recoveries above the literature 0.71-0.81 are not demonstrated.

fehe_hot_end_approach_K at its lower bound (20): bound-driven, not a discovered interior optimum. FEHE area is not costed: the plant-level CAPEX correlation (economics.yaml capex_references) scales with H2 capacity only, so a tighter approach is 'free' heat recovery in this model.

Reactor pressure optimum coincides with the lowest pressure that needs no cracked-gas compression; it moves with the assumed PSA feed-pressure requirement (alternatives 2.5 and 15 bar in separation.yaml) and compressor CAPEX is not costed.

solver.success_note: success = DE converged within maxiter AND the reported point is feasible; DE stopping at maxiter with a converged SLSQP polish is reported as success=False with the polish status
solver.de_message: Maximum number of iterations has been exceeded.

limitations: Python process model (equilibrium cracker, reduced-order PSA); optimum must be re-solved in Aspen Plus (results/optimisation/aspen_verification.json, coordinator).

definitions.fehe_feasibility: FEHE feasibility: no temperature cross. The process model raises FlowsheetSpecError for a cross (41-point counter-current T-Q profile) or a cold outlet below the cold inlet; g = min internal dT - fehe_min_internal_dT_K (default 0 K = 'no cross'). Model failure counts as infeasible.
definitions.min_nh3_conversion: Minimum equilibrium NH3 conversion, g = X - min_nh3_conversion. DESIGN ASSUMPTION, default 0.95: limits the NH3 load sent to the PSA/tail-gas burner (NOx precursor, not modelled). Literature crackers report 99.42 % and 99.6 % (hansen2024hysys p. 4 Table 3, p. 5 Table 4); a 0.99 variant is reported separately. The baseline (600 degC, 20 bar) has X = 0.981.
definitions.max_cracked_gas_nh3_mole_frac: Optional maximum NH3 mole fraction in S5 (off by default).
definitions.product_purity: H2 purity >= min_h2_purity (default 0.99, separation.yaml product_purity_spec, chopra2026decentralized p. 4 Sec. 2.2). Implied by the reduced-order splitter (fixed N2 slip, NH3/H2O fully retained), so it is reported but practically never active.
definitions.thermal_self_sufficiency: Optional: net_fuel_heat_deficit_kW <= 0 (tail-gas heat covers all external heating), g = -deficit.
definitions.kinetic_feasibility: NOT IMPLEMENTED (unfinished): catalyst-mass bound from amcrax.reactor.
